latin: Qualiter uerum sit quod in Epinomide dicitur, arithmeticam scientiam inter omnes speculatiuas maxime facere ad foelicitatem, intelligi potest per conclusiones nostras de mathematicis.
translation: In what sense it is true, as the Epinomis says, that of all the speculative sciences arithmetic contributes most to happiness, can be grasped through our conclusions on mathematics.
